name: Michał Kowalczyk
headline: Data Engineer | Python, Airflow, GCP
summary: Data Engineer with 5 years of experience designing and maintaining scalable ETL pipelines and cloud-based data infrastructure. Skilled in building automated workflows with Airflow, optimizing SQL-based data models, and deploying data solutions on Google Cloud Platform. Focused on delivering reliable, well-documented data systems that support analytics and business decision-making.

responsibilities: Design and maintain Airflow DAGs for daily ETL pipelines processing transactional and event data
Develop Python scripts for data extraction, transformation, and validation across multiple source systems
Optimize BigQuery SQL queries to improve pipeline performance and reduce processing costs
Collaborate with analytics team to define data models supporting reporting dashboards
Implement monitoring and alerting for pipeline failures using Cloud Monitoring
Built and maintained batch data pipelines using Python and SQL for internal reporting needs
Assisted in migrating on-premise data warehouse workloads to Google Cloud Platform
Wrote unit tests and documentation for ETL processes to improve maintainability
Supported senior engineers in troubleshooting data quality issues
